name: 3d-audio
description: 3D positional audio for FiveM — arbitrary audio files spatialized through Web Audio / Howler.js

scripts.build: npm run clearbuild && npm run typecheck && node build/build-bundle.js && npm run build:web && npm run deploy
scripts.build:scripts: npm run clearbuild && npm run typecheck && node build/build-bundle.js
scripts.watch: npm run clearbuild && cross-env IS_WATCH_MODE=1 node build/build-bundle.js
